articles.summary: AMTD Group Inc. ("AMTD Group"), AMTD IDEA Group ("AMTD IDEA") (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB), AMTD Digital Inc. ("AMTD Digital") (NYSE: HKD) and The Generation Essentials Group ("TGE") (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE), a subsidiary of AMTD Digital, jointly (together, the "Group" or "AMTD") announce the expansion of global footprint of The Art Newspaper. Founded in 1990, The Art Newspaper has grown into a multi-platform brand widely regarded as the "journal of record" and the "art bible" for the global art world. Serving as an authoritative cornerstone for the industry and the designated publication for leading events like Art Basel, Frieze, Art Dubai , and the Venice Biennale, the brand is now rapidly expanding its footprint in Asia with the recent debut of its Hong Kong edition and the upcoming launch of its China edition next month. articles.title: TGE Announces the Expansion of Global Footprint of The Art Newspaper

articles.summary: AMTD Group Inc. ("AMTD Group"), AMTD IDEA Group ("AMTD IDEA") (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB), AMTD Digital Inc. ("AMTD Digital") (NYSE: HKD) and The Generation Essentials Group ("TGE") (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE), a subsidiary of AMTD Digital, jointly (together, the "Group" or "AMTD") announce AMTD is in negotiation as a final stage bidder in relation to the acquisition of a second hotel in New York City. In March 2026, AMTD successfully acquired a hotel located at 39 6th Ave, New York, NY 10013, for a cash consideration of USD69 million, which has now been rebranded successfully as the AMTD IDEA Tribeca Hotel. The newly targeted property is located strategically in the Time Square area. The relevant parties are currently in final negotiation stage and are working towards a definitive purchase agreement, with a target closing date prior to the end of 2026. articles.title: AMTD's TGE in Negotiations to Acquire a second New York Hotel

articles.summary: AMTD Group Inc. ("AMTD Group"), AMTD IDEA Group ("AMTD IDEA") (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB), AMTD Digital Inc. ("AMTD Digital") (NYSE: HKD) and The Generation Essentials Group ("TGE") (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE), a subsidiary of AMTD Digital, jointly (together, the "Group" or "AMTD") announce the successful launch of L'Officiel Coffee Bar in Macao SAR; as well as the further expansion of L'Officiel in Singapore with the addition of Shizhuang and the launch in Taiwan. This dual-pillar expansion across the food beverage and media divisions marks a significant milestone in the L'Officiel's global lifestyle strategy, further consolidating its portfolio to elevate and strengthen L'Officiel's fashion voice on the global stage. The L'Officiel Coffee and Bar celebrated its official opening at City of Dreams in Macao SAR in September 2026.
